test_get_cron_approval_mode_parsing: test the _get_cron_approval_mode function parses config values like deny, approve, off, allow, yes and maps them correctly
test_check_dangerous_command_cron_deny: test check_dangerous_command blocks dangerous commands when HERMES_CRON_SESSION is set and cron_mode is deny
test_check_dangerous_command_cron_approv: test check_dangerous_command allows dangerous commands when HERMES_CRON_SESSION is set and cron_mode is approve
test_check_all_command_guards_cron: test check_all_command_guards respects cron_mode setting and blocks or allows dangerous commands accordingly
test_cron_mode_interactions: test cron_mode does not interfere with other approval bypasses like docker environments yolo mode or non-cron sessions
